pages.title: Wirt's Peg Leg
pages.text: The ancient peg leg of a doomed adventurer, preserved in the deepest shadows.$(br2)Slay the $(1)Warden$(0) in the Deep Dark to retrieve this foundational key.

pages.title: Tome of Town Portal
pages.text: An ancient tome inscribed with dimensional return coordinates.$(br2)Barter gold ingots with Nether $(6)Piglins$(0) until this rare grimoire is relinquished.

pages.title: Transmuting The Key
pages.text: Place $(6)Wirt's Leg$(0) and the $(5)Tome of Town Portal$(0) into the $(5)Transmutation Cube$(0).$(br2)Transmuting will manifest the $(c)Cow Level Portal Key$(0). Right-click on solid ground to tear open the dimensional gateway to the Moo Moo Farm!
